title: Recover a timeout without repeating the user's intent
description: Choose an operation, inject an execution outcome, and set the retry strategy. Watch attempts and external side effects diverge.

operations.label: Read order status
operations.detail: A read-only lookup with no external mutation.

operations.label: Send payment reminder
operations.detail: An externally visible message that should be sent once per task.

operations.label: Refund a payment
operations.detail: A consequential financial write that requires fresh user approval.

faults.label: Clean success
faults.detail: The service commits and returns its response before the deadline.

faults.label: Timeout before commit
faults.detail: The deadline expires before the service applies the operation.

faults.label: Timeout after commit
faults.detail: The service applies the operation, but its response never reaches the caller.

recoveries.label: Stop and reconcile
recoveries.detail: Do not issue another write; inspect authoritative state after an ambiguous result.

recoveries.label: Blind automatic retry
recoveries.detail: Issue the operation again with no stable idempotency key.

recoveries.label: Retry one intent
recoveries.detail: Reuse a stable idempotency key so a duplicate attempt returns the first outcome.
